latestVersion.changelog:
Agent Namer 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Provides a command-line tool to generate and manage "货xx"-style agent names.
- Ensures names reflect agent roles and avoids duplication by status checking.
- Supports viewing, adding, reviving, and deactivating agent names.
- Includes workflow guidance and detailed naming conventions.
